SELECT TOP 20
    ID,
    personname,
    [datetime],
    [date],
    [time],
    direction,
    device
FROM master.dbo.atteninfo
WHERE ID = 'ID101'
ORDER BY [datetime] DESC;



SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM master.dbo.atteninfo
ORDER BY ID;


-- Punches whose ID is not in Employees
SELECT DISTINCT a.ID, a.personname
FROM master.dbo.atteninfo a
LEFT JOIN master.dbo.Employees e ON e.EmployeeNo = a.ID
WHERE e.EmployeeNo IS NULL;

-- Employees with no punches
SELECT e.EmployeeNo, e.Name
FROM master.dbo.Employees e
LEFT JOIN master.dbo.atteninfo a ON a.ID = e.EmployeeNo
WHERE a.ID IS NULL;
